title.en: She may want less, not more
title.hi: Use kam chahiye ho sakta hai, zyada nahi

body.en: Advice, visitors, plans. Around now many mothers want the world quieter. Being the person who says no on her behalf is a real job and it is yours.
body.hi: Salah, mehmaan, plans. Ab aksar mothers duniya ko shaant chahti hain. Uski taraf se mana karne wala insaan banna ek asli kaam hai, aur woh aapka hai.
